subject: general
question: Town Q is to the south-east of Town P. Town R is to the south-west of Town Q. Town R is to the south of Town P. Town S is to the west of Town R. What is the direction of Town P with respect to Town S?
solution:
According to the given statements we have:

1) Town Q is to the south-east of Town P.

2) Town R is to the south-west of Town Q.

3) Town R is to the south of Town P. 

4) Town S is to the west of Town R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52ae3319b46783cf46e56ef997702d9e4c3d7a929c251f8717657e43ea8f96bc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd6911c4f23d651c3f48d08780f9125a52e9b05028c2ef64d3909174323fad4d.png] 

Thus, the direction of Town P with respect to Town S is **North-East**.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
